title: Spurs rally to beat Lakers, advance in NBA Cup
summary: The San Antonio Spurs erased a 20-point deficit to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 99-96 on Friday and punch their ticket to the NBA Cup quarter-finals on the final night of group play.
